goal: Expose the now-restartable connected-system ecosystem through one bounded HTTP interface so human activations, queue inspection, explicit note/task admission, and handoff results can enter the same durable runtime without bypassing system-local boundaries.
next_movement: Build a small persistent ecosystem HTTP service over the demonstrated runtime: activation endpoint (`ohayo` + actor), live handoff/task queue, Personal Operations note/task intake with explicit admission, result-return endpoint, and system/runtime status. Use durable local stores/journal underneath and keep Online School's existing HTTP app as a system-specific surface rather than duplicating its entire UI.
walls: Do not redefine A/B as the HTTP service, runtime, orchestrator, recovery mechanism, planner, school, or factory.
Do not let the HTTP API bypass system-local admission/reconciliation contracts.
Do not let note creation automatically create a task or handoff.
Do not let an activation mutate state merely by being requested.
Do not accept COMPLETE without the handoff's required admissible evidence.
Do not expose private live Personal Operations state through repository commits.
Do not duplicate existing Online School UI/state when a shared adapter can connect it.
